Date: August 28, 2026
Alex Sample
48 Example Avenue
New Brunswick, NJ 08901
Participant ID: TFC-20931
Claim Reference: LBS-88412-B
Plan: Tidewater Fabrication Co. Employee Health Plan
EXPLANATION OF DENIED CLAIM
Dear Alex Sample:
We processed the claim for an outpatient physical therapy evaluation on August 2, 2026,
billed by Shoreline Motion Therapy.
Reason for denial
The claim was denied because the provider is out of network and your plan does not cover
out-of-network services except in emergencies.
Appeal procedures
You may appeal this decision by sending a written request for review to the Plan
Administrator at the address above. Your appeal must be filed within 180 days after you
receive this notice. You have the right to submit written comments, documents, and records,
and to receive copies of documents relevant to your claim.
The Tidewater Fabrication Co. Employee Health Plan is a self-funded group health plan
governed by ERISA. After a final internal decision, you may request an external review by an
independent review organization through the Plan within 4 months.
You also have the right to bring a civil action under section 502(a) of ERISA following an
adverse decision on appeal.
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - NOT A REAL LETTER - created for Medicom demo mode - Page 1 of 1
